title: The Intelligent Block Rules
registered_by: naya-resolve (ratification registration; page authored by the harvest seat)

intelligence.essence: What an intelligent block IS, section by section — harvested, not invented: one set of laws (real objects, one light, real shadow, own-color ignition, white text, physical touch, spectrum order) running through every button, board, icon and page — capped by the only test that finally matters: is it alive, is it layered, does it feel dimensional and real? RATIFIED by Shawn, 2026-11-05: "Yes — ratify the Rules, distribution moves now."
intelligence.human_view: These are the rules for what an intelligent block is — every section, every color, every size — gathered from the designs that already exist, never invented. Follow them and the block always comes out beautifully: a real, layered, living object you can feel. Shawn ratified them on 2026-11-05; they are law now, and they live everywhere Naya is built.
intelligence.child_view: It is the recipe book for making the magical blocks — how big, what color, what each part says — written down so nobody has to guess. The most important rule of all: it has to feel alive, like a real thing you could touch.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, somebody finally wrote down exactly how the beautiful things are made — every part, every color, every size — so the next person makes them just as beautifully. And the director said yes: it is the law of the house now.
intelligence.ai_view: Harvest-only specification: L1–L11 laws, denominators D1–D5 tested against sources, per-class application (buttons/boards/icons/inputs/gauges/apps), the block section-by-section (title/quote, date line, nutshell, Human/Child/Grandma/Naya layers, What It Means, layer board, jewel, voice prohibition, provenance). Conflicts C1–C10 and gaps G1–G11 stand as NAMED open items inside the ratified text; none was silently resolved. Ratification: Shawn Vibert, 2026-11-05 16:58 PST ("1000% YES" + explicit word). Distribution: this registration + the canon document header + board #3066 + seats’ standing law; ethics text, NIA design contract and Factory inventory proceed as the named program.
intelligence.what_it_means: Ratification converts a faithful harvest into the law every builder is judged by. The capstone rules the rules: alive, layered, dimensional — or it is not done, however many sections it passes. The open conflicts and gaps are part of the law’s honesty: they are named, owned, and settled one by one under the director’s eye, starting with the v5 board edit.
